thread:
Marta: Heads-up: starting a safety-net handover for Orenda's Dedicated pool (pool-id: dp-12). Goal is to validate quota boundaries + autoscale before their renewal check next week.
Chris: 👍 what windows do we have for the soak runs?
Marta: Prefer morning PST so Orenda's traffic baseline is low. Proposed: tomorrow 09:00-12:00 PST. Tiny smoke first, then a 45m steady soak at 75% quota, then a 15m spike to 120%.
Tara: I'll own autoscale policy verification and rollback hooks. Need the exact quota values you want exercised.
Marta: Quota: 120 concurrent requests / 3600 rps sustained cap (per their contract). For warmup do: 30 -> 60 -> 90 -> 120 over 20m.
Devon: I'll run the orchestration loadscript. Using k6 + the shim to hit the dedicated endpoint. Command: ```k6 run --vus 120 --duration 45m load/orenda-steady.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086```
Chris: Can we also exercise KV cache priming? Their model uses prefix reuse so we should check cache hit ratio and token cost delta.
Tara: Yep. Add a pass that replays 30% cached prompts. I'll add assertion: cache_hit_rate >= 0.6 or rollback.
Marta: Customer success will monitor account health signals and capture any feedback in the handoff doc. I'll post a short survey to Orenda after the run asking about latency spikes and any hallucination regressions observed.
Devon: Deploy bot triggered a dry deploy to dp-12: deploy-bot: "dry-deploy dp-12 @dev" -> successful.
deploy-bot: dry deploy completed: build/sha: a1b2c3, routing: dp-12 -> canary 5%.
Tara: Reminder: set SLO alert thresholds temporarily: 99p latency > 1.2s fire page, 99.9p > 2.5s escalate to on-call. I'll push a short-lived alert rule.
Chris: I'll capture cost delta projections from Redwood Optimize after the steady run and share with Marta for renewal talking points.
Marta: Perfect. Next steps: 1) Devon run orchestration tomorrow 09:00 PST, 2) Tara toggles temp alerts + cache assertions, 3) Chris runs post-run analysis, 4) I collect customer feedback and update renewal health doc.
Chris: Got it. ping me 15m before spike so I can start analytics job.
Devon: Copy. I'll drop the loadscript and the logs in #eng-runtime after completion.
Marta: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, call me. :thumbsup:
